name: Classical Logic
author: pugmire

LEM.proof: max(v,1-v)=1 for all v in {0,1}. v=0: 1. v=1: 1.

explicit_failures: Liar paradox: v=1-v has no fixed point in {0,1}
Russell's paradox: self-referential set membership collapses level structure
Yablo sequence: infinite construction cost, no seed state
notes: The two-element carrier. LNC and LEM are arithmetic facts, not axioms.
